senses.def: Is equivalent to; implies and is implied by; is true and false in the same cases as.
ex: A rectangle is a square if and only if all four of its sides have the same length.
An integer is even if and only if its square is also even.

senses.def: Synonym of if (with added intensity)
ex: I'll let you go to the concert if and only if you clean your room.

senses.def: At the time of an event, contingent on that event happening at all.
Used to suggest or state tentatively that something may be the case (often the opposite of something previously implied).
ex: The situation is, if anything, worsening rather than improving.
“Do you think she’s tall?” / “Oh, no. If anything, she’s short.”

senses.def: Used in questions when the speaker does not know for sure if the listener will have an answer.
ex: What can you tell me, if anything, about this book?

senses.def: If that condition is met; if the situation presents itself; in the event of the case happening; when circumstances so require.
Synonym of if anything.
Persistence is important in the pursuit of success.
